description: Defines data models for notes, including Note and NoteEntity classes, with Room database annotations, serialization, and parcelable implementation. Contains methods for note manipulation and conversion.

classes.name: NoteEntity
classes.description: Data class representing a note entity for database storage with Room annotations, including foreign key to Notebook.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data class representing a note with additional properties, relations, and utility methods, implementing Parcelable.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the note is empty based on title, content, attachments, reminders, tags, and task list.

methods.name: stringToTaskList
methods.description: Converts note content lines into a list of NoteTask objects.

methods.name: mdToTaskList
methods.description: Parses markdown list syntax in content to create a list of NoteTask objects.

methods.name: toStorableContent
methods.description: Returns note content or markdown list representation based on isList flag.

methods.name: taskListToMd
methods.description: Converts task list to markdown formatted string.

methods.name: taskListToString
methods.description: Converts task list to plain string, optionally with checkmarks.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts Note object to NoteEntity for database storage.
